# StateSpaceSequenceModeling

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A framework that represents sequential data as latent state transitions, enabling efficient long-range dependency modeling with linear complexity. Offers a scalable alternative to attention mechanisms for TCC's network-wide state tracking and resource-constrained in-network processing.
